title: M7 Themes: selectable color schemes
description: Operator finds the default TUI colors hard to read and wants a way to switch color schemes. Current styles are hard-coded in internal/tui/render.go: dim = ANSI color 8 (gray, likely the main readability problem on dark backgrounds), errText = ANSI 1 (red), selection/active tab = reverse video, headings = bold. Ideas to brainstorm (not decided): a theme setting in config (e.g. theme = "default" | "high-contrast" | "light" | "mono"), a key to cycle themes live in the TUI, honoring NO_COLOR, and possibly user-defined colors. Needs a short brainstorm with the operator first: which elements are hard to read and in what terminal background. Do after M6 (both touch internal/tui/render.go).
close_reason: M7 themes on branch m7-themes; review fixes applied; verified live

title: Themes follow-ups: validation scope
description: Deferred from expanded M7 review: (1) SaveViews runs full config Validate, which re-reads theme files on every view save; a theme broken while Ghost runs blocks view saves — validate views only there; (2) ghost review fails on a broken theme file — consider validating themes only for the TUI and --check.

title: M6 review follow-ups: view edge cases
description: Deferred minors from M6 review: (1) views.toml from a newer Ghost fails with a generic unknown-keys error — mention 'written by a newer Ghost?'; (2) SaveViews runs full Validate, so a prompt_file broken after startup blocks view saves — validate views only; (3) ctrl+c ignored inside the view form; (4) m.prs/m.errs keep entries for deleted or renamed views; (5) defensive active index when editing a view whose name is missing. See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-10-m6-views.md.

title: Follow-up review minors: TUI actions outlive shutdown; stale recheck overwrite
description: From the follow-ups review: (1) a/P TUI actions run with context.Background() outside the engine WaitGroup, so quitting mid-approve leaves 'approving' (settled to unknown on next start; safe but untidy) — route them through the engine; (2) a recheck holding a stale review can briefly overwrite a supersede with 'pending' via full-row SaveReview (approve still blocks; cosmetic) — use targeted UPDATEs for approval fields.
